questions.stem_text:
Bernstein thought that using 'restricted codes' of language disadvantaged pupils at school
because:

options.A: this pattern of speech made them the target of bullying
options.B: they referred to explicit, context independent meanings
options.C: they prevented children from communicating outside of their peer groups
options.D: they involved short, simple sentences with a small vocabulary

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - they involved short, simple sentences with a small vocabulary

questions.stem_text:
Mulholland (1998) argued that privatization changed the relationship between companies and
managers in that:

options.A: flexibility was reduced by the introduction of detailed daily worksheets
options.B: the state had greater control than managers over production processes
options.C: ownership was transferred from small shareholders to senior managers
options.D: employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - employment depended on performance rather than trust and commitment

questions.stem_text: How is terrorism different from the types of crime described by the Chicago School?

options.A: it is committed on a larger, often global, scale, and is well organized
options.B: it is associated with political conflict between states and their citizens
options.C: it can have far-reaching effects upon international relations

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text: The middle classes that developed over the nineteenth century were:

options.A: an urban set, involved in civic bodies and voluntary associations
options.B: too diverse to have a strong sense of class consciousness

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text:
The capitalist class of the mid-twentieth century were said to join the upper class
because they:

options.A: participated in the same leisure pursuits and events of the 'social calendar'
options.B: emulated the lifestyle and cultural values of the traditional aristocracy
options.C: owned companies and financial assets that generated wealth through corporations
options.D: had direct, personal ownerships of land and businesses as physical assets

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - owned companies and financial assets that generated wealth through corporations
